mapper.select: SELECT g.domain AS domain, h.recorded_on AS recorded_on, AVG(h.progress_pct) AS avg_progress FROM iep_goal_progress_history h JOIN iep_goals g ON g.id = h.goal_id JOIN iep_programs p ON p.id = g.iep_id WHERE h.recorded_on >= #{fromDate} AND p.student_id IN #{sid} GROUP BY g.domain, h.recorded_on ORDER BY h.recorded_on
SELECT disability_type AS label, COUNT(*) AS total FROM students WHERE active = TRUE GROUP BY disability_type ORDER BY total DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM iep_programs WHERE status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM behavior_incidents WHERE incident_date >= #{fromDate}
